dogecoin.text: In addition, instead of using the $DOGE native bridge, you can get your $DOGE to Dogechain via Router by enabling the Gas TopUp function.

This is filling in the gap that the Multichain bridge left after its breach and dissolution and is also advancing the concept of Doge Finance (DogeFi) that boosts liquidity and other financial activities for $DOGE and other Dogechain-based assets.
